additional_info.subject: 0376781 - ID0376781-DC/Si-D/IT-[170002556] Phase imbalance error, charger not commissioned CRM:00472000196
additional_info.body:
Hello Luca,
After today's intervention, it was possible to identify the root cause of the issue.
Charger is reporting income phase loss:
After measuring the internal phases, we observed that L1 voltage was missing when suppling the converters.
Suply from grid was correct:
L1 - L2 -> 405 V
L2 - L3 -> 405 V
L1 - L3 -> 405 V
On the inside of the charger and after the AC filter we had:
L1 - L2 -> 202 V
L2 - L3 -> 405 V
L1 - L3 -> 202 V
And measuring before the AC filter the same values.
It was not visible any loose wire/copper bar between AC filter and the MCCB.
The MCCB F09-QA1 is defect and must be replaced. (Internally, L1 phase contact is not properly closing)
MLFB for the part is: 3VA1463-6EF42-0AA0
Thank you and your colleague for your efforts during our intervention onsite.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
